## 2026-09-22 — Q4.2: Field registry and entity-type matrix

**Bucket:** [Standard]/AI-draftable for field registry shape (established
pattern from three prior domains); [Org-decision] flagged inline where a
field has no clean ownership (Orchestration Reference, forward reference
to Workflow/Process).

**Answer:** 10 domain-owned fields across 6 entity types (Database, Data
Warehouse/Lakehouse, Data Lake, Vector Database, Stream/Topic, Data
Pipeline). Retention Policy Reference deliberately points to Data/
Metadata's Data Retention Period rather than duplicating a value —
mirrors System Architecture's Database Engine field pattern (this domain
records the pointer, the owning domain records the value).

**Status:** Pending explicit review.
